invocation_metadata.response_schema_scope: Prompt guidance and strict local validation only; no provider enforcement claim

findings.assessment: SPEC.md formalizes criteria C01-C12 aligned with contract.txt, covering binary size limits, strict UTF-8 decoding, line delimitation, duplicate key rejection, exact integer types without boolean/float coercion, and atomic batch output with exit code 2 on failure.

DESIGN.md evaluates explicit architecture alternatives (batch retention vs immediate emission, bounded read vs unbounded read, custom json object_pairs_hook vs default parser) and details standard library implementation choices adhering to zero-external-dependency constraints.
TASKS.md establishes sequential dependencies (T01-T07), preserves the protocol sealing order prior to test construction, and maps verification cases V01-V08 directly to acceptance criteria C01-C12.

result.reason: The specification, design, and task decomposition thoroughly capture all functional requirements, edge cases, type constraints, and architectural restrictions defined in contract.txt without omissions.
